summary.text: Keith Ellison is the DFL Attorney General of Minnesota and won a third term on November 3, 2026, according to unofficial results.

Before becoming attorney general in 2019 he served in the Minnesota House and then in the U.S. House for Minnesota's 5th District; as attorney general his office has prosecuted Medicaid and child-nutrition fraud and brought consumer, antitrust and multistate suits against corporations and the Trump administration.

paragraphs.text: Ellison began his legislative career in the Minnesota House of Representatives, where he served District 58B from 2003 through 2006.
He then represented Minnesota's 5th District in the U.S. House from January 2007 to January 2019.
Ellison took office as Minnesota attorney general in January 2019.
In his KAXE candidate questionnaire he describes having been elected to two terms and lists North Minneapolis as his community.
He won the November 3, 2026 general election for Attorney General of Minnesota with 54.3% of the vote to Ronald Schutz's 45.6%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
